question: How must the prescribed gifts be offered to the teacher in connection with the Aghora mantra?
premises: The Aghora mantra must be repeated one hundred times.
The previously listed items must be given.
The giving must be done with respect to the teacher.
inference: After repeating the Aghora mantra one hundred times, one should respectfully give those items to the teacher.
plain_english: Having repeated the Aghora mantra one hundred times, one should respectfully give those items to the teacher.
